title: Nine things you might not know about older people in the UK

breadcrumb.text: Nine things you might not know about older people in the UK

body.text: 1 October 2015
There are around 600 million people over the age of 60 across the globe; a figure which is expected to double by 2025, according to the United Nations.

The organisation has designated October 1 as [International Day of Older Person](http://undesadspd.org/ageing/internationaldayofolderpersons.aspx)s (IDOP). UK Older People's Day is also held on October 1 each year, to celebrate the contributions of older people to society.
To mark IDOP 2015, here are nine facts you may not know about older people.

body.h4: 1. There were more than half a million people aged 90 and over living in the UK in 2014, almost triple the number thirty years ago.
